overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a targeted social media presence across academic and professional networks (LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon), boasting a total follower base of 3,580. Content consistently revolves around computational social science, coordinated inauthentic behavior, tool releases, and academic recruitment, achieving strong engagement particularly within niche decentralized communities.

contentThemes.description: Sharing newly published academic papers, grants, and study findings related to information operations.
Updates on analytical software like CooRnet and discussions on platform methodology.
Posts recruiting postdoctoral researchers and PhD students for computational social science projects.

recommendations: Cross-promote major research breakthroughs and software releases across all three platforms simultaneously to maximize reach.
Increase direct call-to-actions and discussion prompts on Mastodon and LinkedIn to convert likes into deeper conversational engagement.
Leverage Bluesky's high resharing rate by formatting announcements as easily shareable snippets and thread summaries.

platformInsights.bluesky: Yields the highest engagement rate (average 6.14%), driven by high repost counts on publication announcements and opportunity postings.
platformInsights.mastodon: Serves well for technical and methodological tool updates (e.g., CooRnet v2.0), showing a dedicated audience interested in open-source methods.
platformInsights.linkedin: Generates the highest absolute engagement volume, making it the ideal platform for major career milestones, grants, and recruitment drives.
